dedupe_keys.name: calliope italy 20 region model of the italian energy system

description: Calliope-Italy is an open model of the Italian electricity system with 20 regions, covering current and 2050 technology options, built on the Calliope framework (version 0.6.4). It was developed by Francesco Lombardi and published on GitHub with Zenodo releases from 2020, to explore decarbonisation options for Italy. A distinctive feature is the generation of spatially-explicit practically-optimal results (SPORES), a set of near-optimal alternatives, not a single least-cost design. Version 0.2 added power-to-gas options such as electrolysers and methanation with direct air capture, and use of carbon-neutral gas in the existing gas network, storage and turbines. All input data and model specifications are in the repository, with time series indexed to 2015, the year first used to test the model against transmission operator data, a reference weather year of 2016, and any weather year from 1981 to 2016 selectable. Coverage is Italy. The model is accessible on GitHub and downloadable from Zenodo at no cost. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): CC-BY-4.0. Simulation uses are capacity expansion and near-optimal alternative analysis for Italian decarbonisation. Related records: model-calliope is the framework. The underlying files were not downloaded, so their contents are not verified here.
